evidence_semantics.automated_qa: Every compiled support row carries all 24 ordered gate outcomes and evidence fingerprints.
evidence_semantics.provider_assertion: GBIF provider identity is preserved as provider-asserted and unreviewed.
evidence_semantics.yoloe_scope: Quality, visual-domain, subject-area and life-stage routing only.

limitations: No live GBIF production support bank was populated during Phase 2; artifact contracts were exercised with deterministic fixtures.
Adaptive provisional support is not connected to readiness, embedding, prototype or production scoring until later phases.
Provisional provider assertions are not human verification, calibration evidence or scientific-release permission.
No time-saved, review-work-saved or scoring-quality improvement is claimed from Phase 2 tests.

verification: 24 canonical gates always emitted
admitted, excluded and review_required precedence
provider assertion cannot become human verification
global references may lack geography but cannot become geographic prototypes
